symbolic_metric_review.determinant: Rows65-69 expand the determinant of three Cartesian edge vectors using every permutation and its inversion parity. This is distinct from the worker cross/transform/cofactor path.
symbolic_metric_review.edge_face_formula: Rows78-90 independently sum six squared lengths L and four Gram determinants M. For ideal unit-edge reference W, G=W^T W=(I+11^T)/2, G^-1=2I-11^T/2 and det(G)=1/2. Thus norm(J)^2=L/2 and det(J)^2=2D^2. For C=cof(A), cof(W^-1)cof(W^-1)^T=2G=I+11^T, so norm(cof(J))^2=sum|C_i|^2+|sum C_i|^2=M. Therefore squared inverse-Frobenius SICN is36D^2/(L M). This is symbolic reasoning only.
symbolic_metric_review.orientation_and_degeneracy: Gram terms are squared face areas. Nonzero D gives positive L and M. If L M=0 the metric is None; a planar noncollapsed case can have D=0 and Q2=0. The unchanged gate is separately D>0 and exact Q2>=1/100, without square root, floating inverse or tolerance.
symbolic_metric_review.units: D and D/6 have mm^3 units, L has mm^2, M has mm^4, Q2 is dimensionless. Signed zero is irrelevant to rational geometry but is separately preserved by words/packed-bit associations.
